description: Only when ui_tree shows almost nothing (games, Qt, Sciter, canvas UIs): the window's text read by Windows OCR, one line per text with a ref (t3) and screen rect. ui_act takes a t-ref for click, double-click, right-click, hover, wheel and drag, posted at the text's center as mouse messages (no real cursor, no focus change). About 0.5 to 2 s; works while covered. t-refs expire after 60 s.

title.description: part of the window title (case-insensitive; an exact title wins) or a handle from list_windows (0x...)

name: ui_ocr
